import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

records=[]; cur={}

    if not line:
        if cur: records.append(cur); cur={}
        continue
    k,_,v=line.partition(' '); cur[k]=v
seen=set()
for rec in records:
    path=Path(rec['worktree'])
    if not path.exists(): continue
    b=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(path),'symbolic-ref','--quiet','--short','HEAD'],text=True,capture_output=True)

    name=b.stdout.strip()
    if name in seen: continue
    seen.add(name)
    head=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(path),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
